segments.source: 1. Rewrite the facts as arrows: North Fork→Meadow River, Red Brook→Meadow River, Meadow River→Blue Creek. 2. Follow arrows starting from North Fork. 3. An arrow path reaches Blue Creek, so North Fork is upstream of Blue Creek.
segments.translation: 1. Rescriem faptele ca săgeți: North Fork→Meadow River, Red Brook→Meadow River, Meadow River→Blue Creek. 2. Urmărim săgețile pornind de la North Fork. 3. Un drum de săgeți ajunge la Blue Creek, deci North Fork se află în amonte de Blue Creek.

segments.source: Answer.
segments.translation: Răspuns.

segments.source: Yes; water from North Fork can reach Blue Creek.
segments.translation: Da; apa din North Fork poate ajunge în Blue Creek.

segments.source: Knowledge takeaway.

segments.source: A river network can be reasoned about like any directed network; following the arrows is more reliable than guessing from names.

segments.source: Problem 12. Following water from Pine River
segments.translation: Problema 12. Urmărind apa de la Pine River

segments.source: Knowledge context.
segments.translation: Context de cunoaștere.

segments.source: River systems form directed networks: water has a direction, tributaries join larger streams, and upstream/downstream are relational concepts.
segments.translation: Sistemele de râuri formează rețele orientate: apa are o direcție, afluenții se varsă în cursuri mai mari, iar amonte/aval sunt concepte relaționale.

segments.source: Given facts.
segments.translation: Fapte date.

segments.source: North Fork flows into Clearwater; Pine River flows into Clearwater; Clearwater flows into Meadow River.
segments.translation: North Fork se varsă în Clearwater; Pine River se varsă în Clearwater; Clearwater se varsă în Meadow River.

segments.source: Rules.
segments.translation: Reguli.

segments.source: If river X flows into river Y, X is upstream of Y. Upstream relations can be followed through several confluences. Downstream is the reverse direction of flow.
segments.translation: Dacă râul X se varsă în râul Y, X se află în amonte de Y. Relațiile de tip amonte pot fi urmărite prin mai multe confluențe. Avalul este direcția inversă a curgerii.
